name: vision_simclr_bad
title: The same SimCLR project with seven planted defects
origin: domain-vision round 1: the dirty twin of vision_simclr

expected.defect: the projection head ends in nn.Softmax and the NT-Xent similarity logits are then handed to nn.CrossEntropyLoss
expected.why: the projections are a probability simplex rather than a direction, so the cosine similarity is meaningless and the loss log-softmaxes an already-normalised quantity
expected.gap: MLV401 traces the SSA chain of the loss input back to a softmax. The NT-Xent input is projections @ projections.t() / TEMPERATURE then masked_fill - a matmul of the model output with itself, not a producer chain - so the nn.Softmax closing the projection head is not reachable by the documented walk.

expected.defect: evaluate() never calls eval() on the encoder or the classifier
expected.why: the ResNet-18 encoder's BatchNorm layers keep updating their running statistics from the test set while the test accuracy is being computed

expected.defect: the linear probe's train and test pipelines carry RandomResizedCrop, RandomHorizontalFlip and RandomGrayscale
expected.why: the probe measures the representation on randomly cropped, grayscaled images, so the reported linear-probe accuracy is not the number the paper's protocol defines
the whole encoder graph is built for every test batch and dropped

expected.defect: the contrastive loss is accumulated as a live tensor, and the accumulator is never reset
expected.why: every batch's graph is retained for the whole run, not just the epoch

expected.defect: the pre-training loader does not shuffle
expected.why: NT-Xent's negatives are the other images in the batch, so an unshuffled class-ordered batch makes every negative a same-class image and the objective is actively wrong

expected.defect: the whole module is pickled instead of its state_dict
expected.why: the encoder checkpoint carries the class path and stops loading when pretrain.py moves

forbidden.why: the probe's test loader still passes shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside factory functions reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is still called in both loops
optimizer.step() is still called in both loops
backward() still precedes step() in both loops
no backward() call is inside a no_grad region
CosineAnnealingLR is still stepped once per epoch
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss in this project
both views and every probe batch are still moved to the device
there is no run-time split in this project
the projector is still an nn.Sequential

gaps.what: TwoCropsTransform applies the pipeline once and returns the same tensor twice, so the two contrastive views are identical, the positive pair is trivial and the representation learns nothing - no rule covers a multi-view transform that collapses its views
gaps.evidence: data.py:51-53 against the clean twin's two independent calls

gaps.what: the linear probe no longer wraps the feature extraction in no_grad, so the 'frozen' encoder is trained by the probe's optimiser through the classifier's graph
gaps.evidence: pretrain.py:118 against the clean twin's with torch.no_grad() block
